attempts.execution_mode: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE <target> AS newline + unchanged frozen SELECT body; no official _process_sql trim or schema rewrite
attempts.input_policy: gold private copy; restore only target before and after; all other upstream relations remain gold
attempts.clock_assumption: 010 policy: date literals; timestamp 00:00:00 UTC placeholder; unknown historical time and timezone

output_lineage.method: SQLGlot output value lineage through local CTEs/subqueries; filter-only clocks do not imply every output value depends on time

change.definition: Compare absolute row delta, pred-only/gold-only key counts, and per-column L0/L3 mismatch and unmatched-occurrence counts. Shrunk means every comparable component non-increasing and at least one smaller, with no unavailable component. No sum or causal attribution.

aggregate.summary_rule: For ambiguous dates, any matching date is counted once at the best observed level. Otherwise any strict componentwise reduction is counted as shrink; unchanged requires all dates unchanged. Individual dates remain separate; no historical date is chosen.
